personas.blurb: Computer Engineering junior selling her old desk setup and dorm gear. Has buyers messaging her.
Freshman furnishing a dorm on a budget, with a few conversations going (including a sketchy one).
Campus moderator. Reviews flagged listings, message reports and support tickets.

listings.title: IKEA Micke desk (white)
listings.description: Compact white desk with a drawer and a cable outlet. Fits the Chapultepec and Granada dorm rooms perfectly. Light scuffs on the top. Pickup near the Trolley stop.

listings.title: 27" Dell gaming monitor (1440p, 165Hz)
listings.description: Dell S2721DGF, barely used since I moved to a laptop-only setup. Comes with the original stand and a DisplayPort cable.

listings.title: Mechanical keyboard, brown switches
listings.description: Keychron K2 with Gateron browns. Bluetooth and USB-C. Quiet enough for late-night coding without waking your roommate (mostly).

listings.title: TI-84 Plus CE graphing calculator
listings.description: Got me through Calc 1-3 and Linear Algebra. Rechargeable over USB, case included.

listings.title: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, 7th edition
listings.description: Alexander and Sadiku, required for the intro circuits course. Highlighting in chapters 1-6, otherwise clean.

listings.title: LED desk lamp with USB charging port
listings.description: Three brightness levels plus warm and cool light. Clamps onto the edge of a desk.

listings.title: Ergonomic mesh office chair
listings.description: Adjustable lumbar support and armrests. Saved my back during finals week. Pickup only, it's bulky.

listings.title: Raspberry Pi 4 (4GB) starter kit
listings.description: Includes a case, fan, power supply and a 32GB microSD card with Raspberry Pi OS. Used for one class project.

listings.title: Pothos plant in a ceramic planter
listings.description: Healthy, very forgiving houseplant. Survived a whole semester of me forgetting to water it.

listings.title: Organic Chemistry (Klein, 4th edition)
listings.description: For the organic chemistry sequence. Light pencil notes in the margins, solutions manual included.

listings.title: Campbell Biology, 12th edition
listings.description: Cover is worn but every page is intact. Used for the intro biology sequence.

listings.title: Mini fridge with freezer box (3.1 cu ft)
listings.description: Keeps drinks cold and fits under a lofted bed. Cleaned and defrosted, ready to go.

listings.title: Compact microwave, 700W
listings.description: Works great for ramen and leftovers. Check your residence hall's appliance rules first.

listings.title: Lab coat and safety goggles (size M)
listings.description: Required for chem labs. Washed, no stains.

listings.title: Road bike, 54cm aluminum frame
listings.description: Shimano Claris groupset, new tires and brake pads last month. Great for commuting to campus.

listings.title: Kryptonite U-lock with cable
listings.description: U-lock plus a 4ft cable for the front wheel. Two keys included.

listings.title: 7'0" soft-top surfboard
listings.description: Foam funboard, perfect for learning at Pacific Beach. A few dings, no leaks. Leash included.

listings.title: Complete skateboard
listings.description: 8 inch deck, smooth bearings, fresh grip tape. Fastest way across campus between classes.

listings.title: Bike helmet (size M), new with tags
listings.description: Bought the wrong size and never wore it.

listings.title: Nintendo Switch OLED with two games
listings.description: White OLED model with dock and two Joy-Cons, plus Mario Kart 8 and Animal Crossing. Screen protector since day one.

listings.title: Grand Theft Auto V (PS5)
listings.description: Disc is in great condition and works perfectly.

listings.title: Sony WH-1000XM4 noise-cancelling headphones
listings.description: Best purchase I made for studying in the library. Includes the case and cable, 30-hour battery.

listings.title: Yamaha FG800 acoustic guitar
listings.description: Comes with a gig bag, spare strings and a capo. A great beginner guitar.

listings.title: Two student tickets: Aztecs football vs. Fresno State
listings.description: Two student-section seats for Saturday's home game. Price is for both, transferable through the ticket app.

listings.title: North Face rain jacket (men's L)
listings.description: Waterproof shell that packs into its own pocket. Rarely needed in San Diego, which is why it's for sale.

listings.title: Nike Air Force 1 (men's 10)
listings.description: Worn a handful of times and cleaned. Original box included.

listings.title: Python and Java tutoring for intro CS
listings.description: Senior CS student, $25 an hour. Help with labs, debugging and exam prep. Meet at the library or over Zoom.

listings.title: Twin XL bedding set
listings.description: Comforter, fitted sheet, flat sheet and two pillowcases. Washed, from a smoke-free room.

listings.title: Watercolor set and two sketchbooks
listings.description: Travel watercolor set with brushes and two unused sketchbooks, bought for an intro art class.

listings.title: Over-the-door full-length mirror
listings.description: No cracks, hooks included. Makes a small room feel bigger.

listings.title: Small three-shelf bookcase
listings.description: Some wear on the corners. Making room for a desk, so it needs to go this week.

listings.title: Catan board game, complete
listings.description: Played twice, every piece accounted for. Great for floor game nights.

listings.title: iPhone 16 Pro Max, brand new, $150
listings.description: Brand new, sealed, no box. Cash app or gift cards only. Can't meet in person, I ship same day.
listings.flag_reason: Price far below market and payment requested in gift cards (likely scam).

messages.text: Hi! Is the IKEA desk still available?
Yes it is! Are you on campus this week?
I'm in Chapultepec. Could I pick it up Thursday after 4?
Thursday at 4:30 works. I can meet you by the Trolley stop.
Would you take $65 for the mini fridge?
I could do $70 if you can pick it up this weekend.
Does the monitor come with the stand?
Yep, the original stand and a DisplayPort cable.
hey saw u looking at phones. pay with gift card and i ship today, super cheap
I'd rather meet on campus and pay in person.
no meet. send the gift card code now or someone else gets it

message_reports.reason: Asking for gift card payment and refusing to meet in person.

support_tickets.subject: Photo upload stuck on Safari
support_tickets.message: When I add photos to a listing from my iPhone, the progress bar stops at 90%.

support_tickets.subject: How do I mark a listing as sold?
support_tickets.message: I sold my calculator. Should I delete the listing or is there a sold button?
